title: The determinant of the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for a surface with boundary and periods of holomorphic differentials on its double
summary: Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth orientable $2d$ Riemannian manifold of genus $\mathfrak{g}$ with Riemannian metric $g$ and connected boundary $Γ$. Let $Λ$ be the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map on $Γ$ and let ${\rm det}_ζ(Λ)$ be its (modified, i. e. with zero mode excluded) $ζ$-regularized determinant. It is well-known that the quantity ${\rm det}_ζ(Λ)/|Γ|$ (where $|Γ|$ is the length of $Γ$) is a conformal invariant.
